Name: Tutti Fruity - Yet Another Furniture Recolour (AT or CP)
Author: novust
Description:
[color=#D4D4D8][img]https://i.ibb.co/4nSpk6hp/description.png[/img][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Over 60 vanilla furniture items, each one re-textured into 6 different fruit themes (apple, apricot, cherry, orange, peach, pomegranate), for a total of over 400 items! [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]• Alternative Textures:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Most are re-colours of items originally from the vanilla Furniture Catalogue, with a few that are only available in special circumstances. Can you find them all?[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8](Don't forget to purchase the Paint Bucket from Robin!)[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]• Content Patcher: [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]A custom catalogue to hold it all, available @ Robin's for only 1,000G.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Bonus: You don't need to find or obtain the items that aren't in the vanilla Furniture Catalogue, since they are included! [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Which items?[/color]
[spoiler][color=#D4D4D8]Some museum and secret note rewards, a couple of Desert Festival pieces, and all 3 beds from Penny's 14-heart event.[/color][/spoiler]


[color=#D4D4D8][i]The catalogue is optional; if you want to keep it all in the vanilla one, just delete the folder "Tutti Fruity Furniture Catalogue"[/i][/color]


[img]https://i.ibb.co/FqNzB6cX/requirements-installation.png[/img]

• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], based on which version(s) you choose.
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url] if you want to use my custom catalogue with the Content Patcher version (I highly recommend this, to not clog up the vanilla Furniture Catalogue) 

• Install all prerequisites as well as my mod the regular way, by unzipping the folders and putting them into your Mods folder.

• To uninstall, delete it from your Mods folder. You may want to delete any furniture in-game first, to not be left with red error items.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Hpk9sGcQ/compatibility.png[/img]

Should be compatible with all mods, since it is just furniture.
It is [i]safe[/i] to have both versions of this mod installed at the same time (although redundant)


[color=#D4D4D8][img]https://i.ibb.co/GvhKCwBB/mod-recommendations.png[/img][/color]

• I love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url] for making placing furniture and decor so much better and, well, precise!


[img]https://i.ibb.co/gFvr0wMd/what-s-next.png[/img]

More fruits added to this mod! Which ones would you like to see?


[color=#D4D4D8][img]https://i.ibb.co/bMq0frHX/credits-special-thanks.png[/img][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]• My spouse for helping me learn when I was stuck, and for their encouragement and input.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• [b]ConcernedApe[/b] of course, for making this wonderful game, and for encouraging mods.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Anyone who downloads my mods ☻[/color]
